answer: Jitter-Paced Intermittent Token Churn Nodes must emit heartbeat packets with randomized micro-burst intervals resembling a foraging sparrow rather than a periodic clock. Each logical identity must consume a unique, non-transferable seed thread derived from previous upstream routing latency. An attacker spinning up thousands of sybil nodes faces compounding buffer bloat and packet collisions, degrading their network throughput like cloudy opal under intense heat. The cost is severe CPU starvation and dropped connections.
